svg.title: Probes into Alaska's two-Dan-Sullivan Senate ballot
svg.desc: Graphic poster illustration: under green aurora and the Big Dipper, a giant paper ballot stands like a mountain in the snow of Alaska. Its only readable lines, two names lit in yellow, read 'SULLIVAN, DAN S.' and 'SULLIVAN, DANIEL J. JR.'. Two small investigators in parkas shine flashlights up at those lines while a news camera operator films from the snow.
